title: Economic torts protect against certain intentional interference with contracts, trade or business

content.overview: Economic torts protect against certain intentional interference with contracts, trade or business. The law does not create a general right to be free from competition.
content.study:
Economic torts protect against certain intentional interference with contracts, trade or business. The law does not create a general right to be free from competition.\
\
Lumley v Gye recognised intentional procurement of breach of contract. Mogul Steamship shows that lawful competition causing loss is not itself tortious. The exact economic tort and required intent must be identified.
